title: readcode common definitions
description: Shared shapes referenced by the other readcode schemas.

schemaVersion.description: Study format version. Always 1 in v1.

sha40.description: Full git commit SHA (40 lowercase hex chars).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of a blob's content (64 lowercase hex chars).

path.description: Path relative to the repo root, always with forward slashes.

markdown.description: Markdown text; may contain [[ref:path#symbol]], [[ref:path:L10-31]], [[archify:name]] and mermaid fenced blocks.

range.description: Line range [startLine, endLine], 1-based inclusive. start<=end is checked by `readcode validate`, not by the schema.

studyName.description: Study name: lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit.

nullableRange.description: A range, or null when it does not apply.

url.description: Repository URL (or path) the study was generated from.
